title: CodeCreator Technology
description: Built an SEO-optimized corporate website using Next.js 14 with SSR/SSG architecture spanning 30+ service pages, dynamic blogs, and city-based pages. Integrated WordPress CMS, structured SEO metadata, dark/light themes, and optimized deployment with Docker and Server Components.

screenshots.description: Homepage with navbar and hero element.

title: INDRESH Info Services
description: INDRESH Info Services is a multi-page business website for a technology and consultancy firm, featuring service showcases for IT solutions, ERP/accounting software, overseas admissions, and academic content writing with animated statistics counters and client testimonials. Built with React 19 and Vite, utilizing Tailwind CSS for a modern, mobile-first UI with gradient-rich sections, scroll-triggered animations via Intersection Observer, and React Router for seamless SPA navigation.

screenshots.description: Homepage with navbar and hero element.

title: Aviator Admin Dashboard
description: Developed real-time gaming admin dashboard using React + TypeScript with Socket.io for live monitoring, RBAC implementation, hierarchical user management, automated payroll, and financial analytics. Optimized performance with TanStack Query/SWR and built responsive UI using Material UI and Recharts.

title: AnonTalky || Deating Admin Dashboard
description: AnonTalki Admin – A comprehensive admin dashboard for managing an anonymous dating and conversation platform. It provides real-time user & listener management, chat/call monitoring, financial transaction tracking, and advanced analytics with interactive charts. The panel features role-protected routes, and a responsive MUI interface for seamless administrative operations.

title: Altaf Khan || Portfolio Website
description: Designed and developed a premium, high-performance portfolio website using Reactjs and Tailwind CSS to showcase a professional journey in UI/UX design and full-stack

title: Job Hunt
description: Job Portal — A full-stack job portal web application with Firebase authentication, featuring job search & filtering, application tracking, user dashboard with applied/favorite jobs & alerts, and a blog section. Containerized with Docker and deployed via a CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins with Discord webhook notifications.

screenshots.description: Homepage with navbar and hero element.

title: HRMS
description: HRMS Admin web app built with React + TypeScript for managing employee operations (attendance, leaves, payroll, assets). Features role-based auth, MUI components, REST API integration, and rich UX with charts, notifications, and theme management.

title: Rajasthan Tourism
description: Rajasthan Travel Guide – A comprehensive travel and tourism website for Rajasthan, featuring detailed information about cities, forts, temples, and tourist attractions. The site offers curated tour packages, travel guides, and seamless booking experiences for hotels, flights, and local transport. Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it delivers a responsive, visually immersive interface for exploring Rajasthan's rich culture and heritage.
